messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

You're right to be concerned—2G networks are generally not suitable for MMS. We need to change your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to 4G or 5G networks, which are much better for MMS.

**Step 4: Change network mode preference**
Please use `set_network_mode_preference` with the mode `"4g_5g_preferred"` on your phone. This will allow your phone to connect to the fastest available network (4G or 5G).

Once you've done that, let me know, and we'll check your network status again to see if it has switched to 4G or 5G.

I have changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now I see an excellent signal with 5G and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
